transport.preferred: Entra-authenticated Power Automate custom connector backed by an Azure Function or equivalent approved Microsoft Graph boundary
prohibited: embedded client secret or function key

operations.behavior: Resolve the approved drive and root, create only missing year/company folders with conflictBehavior=fail, and read back the exact driveItem before success. Existing exact folders return created=false.
operations.authorization: Resolve the authenticated caller server-side and verify deal access before Graph mutation.
operations.response: Return exact deal, borrower, folder path, driveItem ID, webUrl, creation flag, verification time, and configuration version.

operations.behavior: Upload the supplied binary bytes beneath the verified company-folder driveItem with conflictBehavior=fail, then GET the resulting driveItem and verify name, size, parent, and webUrl.
operations.authorization: Re-resolve the authenticated caller and deal/folder binding; never trust a client-asserted role.
operations.response: Return exact document/deal/requirement identities, driveItem ID, webUrl, byte length, MIME type, and verification time; report fileMayExist=true on ambiguous or post-upload failure.

operations.behavior: GET the driveItem by pinned drive ID and item ID; verify folder facet, exact governed path, and server-side deal binding.
GET the driveItem by pinned drive ID and item ID; verify file facet, exact parent, name, size, URL, and server-side deal binding.

governance.idempotency: Persist and enforce correlation ID plus operation and deal ID. A replay returns the same verified identity and creates no duplicate.
governance.collision: Never use rename conflict behavior. A name collision must resolve to the already bound deal/borrower or fail closed.
governance.orphanHandling: A post-upload verification or Dataverse persistence failure records an orphan candidate keyed by correlation ID and driveItem ID; the requirement remains unsatisfied until reconciled.
governance.audit: Persist actor, deal, document, requirements, correlation, operation, outcome, item IDs, URLs, hashes, timestamps, and failure classification without file content or tokens.
governance.permissions: Use least-privilege Microsoft Graph application/delegated permission scoped to the Business Lending site; prefer Sites.Selected where the approved boundary supports it.
